items.title: Folio's panels over other apps
steps: Turn on Folio's panels over other apps. Open any app, then use One UI's one-hand operation or a Routine that opens the Notification shade.
Folio's Notification Center should slide down over the app, and close when you tap outside, swipe up, or press Home. Try Quick settings the same way.
On a message, tap Reply: a small box to type in should open over the app, and sending should return you to it. Options and the ... button are on Home only.

items.title: Pick 5, 6 or 7 rows
steps: Open Settings > Home and choose Rows 6, then 7. Look at both screens, folded and open.
Icons get smaller to fit the rows; the cover screen shows the smallest icons. Say if any screen looks too small or scrolls.
Choose Automatic again: it should look exactly as it did before.

items.title: Notification sections
steps: Turn on Notification sections, then pull down Notification Center.
Music or a timer should be under Now, chats under Conversations, and silent apps folded under Quiet with a count. Tap Quiet to open it.
Check nothing urgent (a call, an alarm) is hidden in Quiet, and say what you found there that you would not call quiet.

items.title: The ... button and Clear per app
steps: With Notification sections on, tap the ... on a notification: Open, Snooze, Notification settings and Clear.
Open an app with several notifications and tap Clear next to Show Less: the first tap asks, the second clears only that app.

items.title: Shades on the unfolded screen
steps: On the unfolded screen choose Full screen, Card and Side by side for the unfolded layout, and pull each shade down.
A card should sit under the corner you pulled it from and leave Home visible. Side by side shows both panels on one page.

items.title: Widgets make room for apps
steps: Drag a widget onto a spot with apps, then resize one taller over a row of apps. The apps should move along instead of the spot turning red.
With a full page, the last apps should carry on to a new page. Then use Undo Last Layout Change: everything should return.
Watch that the apps slide into place smoothly, also with Reduce Motion on.

items.title: Add to Home from Spotlight
steps: Search for an app that is not on Home and tap the + on the Top Hit: it should appear on Home, and the row should say On Home.
Try an app that is already on Home, and one inside a folder.

items.title: Smooth animations
steps: Look at each thing above at normal speed, and once with Animation Speed slower. Nothing should pop or jump.
Turn Reduce Motion on: panels and sections should fade, with no sliding or growing.

items.title: The new setup (optional)
steps: Open the new setup from here. Nothing changes unless you choose something.
Look at the starting-point choices, and leave without changing anything if you like.
